description: Combine the five-size integrated solver with the selected direct strict-FP32 n=352 panel-major compact-WY path: preserve n=32/n=512/n=1024 routing and stress suites, reconcile generic reducer storage with three contiguous reflector panels and right-side solves, remove superseded panel-QR/block-four code, and profile all five custom sizes.

Integrated the strict-FP32 panel-major n352 path into the five-size parent while preserving the n512 and n1024 dispatches, but the first build exposed a merge artifact: the n512 branch declared reduce_shared twice. No validation or benchmark ran.

Fixed the merged n512 reducer scope while preserving the five-size dispatch and strict panel-major n352 path. Build, kernelguard, and all 39 official tests pass. Full geomean improves from the first parent's 37056.869 to 36246.231 us; n352 is 4886.279 us, while n32/n176/n512/n1024 standard terms are 68.834/989.075/118336.589/87186.198 us.

Removed the two unreferenced block-four coupling/backtransform kernels, their packed-column helper, and the retired n352 panel-QR staging wrapper while retaining panel QR for the live n176 path. The cleanup deletes 298 lines; build, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass. Full geomean is 36239.621 us versus 36246.231 before cleanup, with n352 4891.250 us and unchanged n512/n1024 standard terms 118096.809/87124.736 us.

Delivered final commit a742efa9fed63bac839b41f9c870c5486d9449b7. The five-size solver now uses the selected strict-FP32 n352 direct path: the clustered reducer emits three panel-major contiguous reflector buffers, each panel forms its Gram data without lower-triangle masking, a right-side triangular solve overwrites dead panel storage, and fused baddbmm applies Q-=W*(V^T*Q). The n32/n176/clustered-n512/n1024 dispatches and repair routes remain intact. After one logged merge build error and its fix, all 39 official tests plus a 36-case n352 dense/structured/mixed/all-LAPACK stress corpus pass. Full geomean is 36239.621 us, improving the first parent 37056.869 by 2.21%; n352 is 4891.250 us versus 6531.642 in the five-size parent. The cleanup removes 298 lines of retired n352 staging/block-four code. Exact-final nsys captures exist for all five sizes under profiles/2026-07-03-13-39-25/brief-28-trial-2-*-a742efa9fed63bac839b41f9c870c5486d9449b7.nsys-rep. N352 is now reducer-dominated at 3.756 ms (80.9%), with panel TRSM about 0.187 ms total and no panel-QR/block-four kernels. Keep the tree moving: integrate any validated n512 serial-tail or per-matrix n1024 routing improvements into this parent; for n352, concrete open directions are a different reducer algorithm or fused strict-FP32 Gram/right-solve/projection primitives.
